priorityList.notes: Potion at the top of the fight if mana is already below 75 percent.
Life Tap to keep casting once mana runs low.
Corruption is cheap sustained damage that does not compete with Shadow Bolt casts.

Soul Fire on cooldown. The engine implements Decimation (440870, sim/warlock/soul_fire.go's applyDecimation) for a build that takes it, but the guide's own level-60 build spends 0 of its 2 points to rush Demonic Pact instead, so on this build Soul Fire just casts on its flat, unshortened 60 second cooldown.
Shadow Bolt is the default filler and what feeds Decimation's proc.
